definition.en: The World Happiness Report is a landmark survey of the state of global happiness that ranks countries based on subjective well-being and various socio-economic indicators.
definition.hi: The World Happiness Report is a landmark survey of the state of global happiness that ranks countries based on subjective well-being and various socio-economic indicators.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, this report is critical for understanding the shift from traditional GDP-centric growth models to holistic human development metrics. It provides a framework for analyzing India's socio-economic performance beyond mere financial statistics.
importanceInUpsc.hi: For UPSC GS-3, this report is critical for understanding the shift from traditional GDP-centric growth models to holistic human development metrics. It provides a framework for analyzing India's socio-economic performance beyond mere financial statistics.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the methodology and key variables used to measure national happiness.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the methodology and key variables used to measure national happiness.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the implications of happiness indices on Indian policy-making and human development goals.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the implications of happiness indices on Indian policy-making and human development goals.
